features.name: Parent–Teen Bridge summaries
acceptanceCriteria: A teen explicitly previews and confirms selected source content before sharing.
A linked parent can read only the generated summary and never raw source content.
Revocation removes access immediately and re-share does not expose stale sources or summaries.
The deployed Worker path is verified with two controlled accounts and cleanup evidence.

verification.blocker: Deploy the reviewed Worker through the canonical Cloudflare path and repeat the controlled two-account proof.

features.rollback: Keep BRIDGE_SUMMARIES_ROLLOUT disabled; revert the Worker deployment or merge commit if the controlled proof fails.

features.name: Se’kret identity boundary and named-companion style engine
acceptanceCriteria: Se’kret never appears as a selectable named companion.
The real Worker and TTS paths consume one canonical versioned style source.
Oracle never appears in user-visible text, speech, archives, notifications, or accessibility labels.
Companion Lab and Playwright prove distinct voices and question-budget enforcement.

verification.blocker: Exact-head CI, Playwright, and deployed style-version telemetry must pass before this can advance to verified or released.

features.rollback: Revert the runtime-activation merge commit; the existing sekret-reply brain remains intact behind the wrapper and no database migration is introduced.

features.name: Founder Control Room operational observability
acceptanceCriteria: Founder-gated screens load real operational records rather than decorative success states.
Every panel displays source freshness and an honest empty or unavailable state.
No raw teen content or raw user identifiers appear in observer panels.
Identity, style, voice, and L4 panels are added only after their runtime or data sources exist.

verification.blocker: Operational data sources exist, but identity/style/L4 observer adapters and freshness evidence are not complete.

features.rollback: Remove the founder route entry and keep operational tables intact; do not expose Control Room routes to teen or parent navigation.

features.name: L4 continuity memory, goals, and reflection
acceptanceCriteria: Memory, goal, and reflection records have ownership, provenance, correction, expiry, and deletion semantics.
RLS and executable denial tests prevent cross-user, parent, anonymous, and unintended service access.
One real user-visible continuity path consumes reviewed memory before broad dashboards are built.
Relationship phase is derived from persisted evidence and never manufactured from empty counters.

verification.blocker: Live Supabase does not contain agent_memories, agent_goals, or reflection_runs. Authorization Phase 0 on issue #344 must precede schema activation.
